## Practical Experience & Projects

1. **Food Safety System Design – Training Project**: Engineered an end-to-end Food Safety Plan model for processing lines, developing 6 operational flowcharts, establishing 4 Critical Control Points (CCPs) with continuous monitoring logs, and formulating 8 CAPA protocols.
2. **Quality and Food Safety Institute**: Audited quality compliance frameworks across 3 international standards (ISO 22000, ISO 50001, ISO 14001), PRPs, and GMP/GHP; spearheaded hazard assessments across 5+ simulated plant lines.
3. **Al-Sad Poultry Production Farms — Poultry Production Trainee**: Supervised production workflows and flock health inspections for batches of 10,000+ birds; maintained 98%+ flock survival rate with farm biosecurity protocols.
4. **LANS Academy (2022–2023) — Sales Representative (Chat Sales)**: Advised 40+ prospective students weekly on medical analysis curricula, converting 20% to paid enrollments; increased registration volume by 25%.
5. **Talabat (2021–2022) — Customer Operations & Dispatch Support**: Resolved 80+ inquiries daily under 3 minutes with 95%+ satisfaction; reduced late delivery exceptions by 15% across 50+ partners per shift.
